NOT_FOUND: The requested resource was not found.
ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: The requested endpoint does not exist.
VALIDATION_ERROR: The submitted data is invalid. Please check your input.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The submitted data is too large. Please reduce the size and try again.
UNAUTHORIZED: You must be logged in to perform this action.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
CONFLICT: A conflict occurred. The resource may already exist.
INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email address or password is incorrect.
SELF_DEACTIVATION: You cannot deactivate your own account.
LAST_ADMIN: Cannot remove the last admin from the system.
OIDC_NOT_CONFIGURED: Single sign-on is not configured for this instance.
OIDC_NO_MATCHING_ACCOUNT: No account was found for your email address. Please contact an administrator to have an account created for you.
OIDC_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Your identity provider did not confirm that your email address is verified.
CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY: This would create a circular dependency.
CATEGORY_IN_USE: This category is in use and cannot be deleted.
VENDOR_IN_USE: This vendor is in use and cannot be deleted.
BUDGET_SOURCE_IN_USE: This budget source is in use and cannot be deleted.
DISCRETIONARY_SOURCE: The discretionary budget source cannot be deleted.
SUBSIDY_PROGRAM_IN_USE: This subsidy program is in use and cannot be deleted.
BUDGET_LINE_IN_USE: This budget line is linked to an invoice and cannot be deleted.
PAPERLESS_NOT_CONFIGURED: The document management integration is not configured.
PAPERLESS_UNREACHABLE: The document management system could not be reached.
PAPERLESS_ERROR: An error occurred while communicating with the document management system.
ITEMIZED_SUM_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: The sum of itemized amounts exceeds the invoice total.
BUDGET_LINE_ALREADY_LINKED: This budget line is already linked to an invoice.
BUDGET_LINE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: This budget line is already assigned to a work item or household item.
RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment before trying again.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account has been temporarily locked due to too many failed login attempts.
INVALID_METADATA: Some entry details are invalid or incomplete (for example, an unfinished signature). Please review the entry and try again.
INVALID_ENTRY_TYPE: This diary entry type is not allowed for this operation.
IMMUTABLE_ENTRY: This diary entry cannot be modified.
BACKUP_IN_PROGRESS: A backup or restore operation is already in progress.
BACKUP_NOT_FOUND: The requested backup archive was not found.
RESTORE_FAILED: The backup archive could not be read, so nothing was restored. Check the file's permissions on the server, then try again.
LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED: AI assistance is not configured on this server.
LLM_UNREACHABLE: The AI service could not be reached. Please try again.
LLM_INVALID_RESPONSE: The AI service returned an unusable response. Please try again.
LLM_UPSTREAM_ERROR: The AI service reported an error. Please try again.
REFUND_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: Refund amount exceeds the invoice total.
INVOICES_NOT_CLAIMABLE: One or more invoices could not be marked as submitted. They may already be submitted, or their status does not allow it.
INVOICE_NOT_QUOTATION: This invoice is not a quotation and cannot be converted.
ALREADY_SAVED: This diary entry has already been saved.
AREA_IN_USE: This area is in use and cannot be deleted.
TRADE_IN_USE: This trade is in use and cannot be deleted.
BACKUP_FAILED: The backup could not be created. Please try again.
SAME_SOURCE: The source and target budget source must be different.
STALE_OWNERSHIP: One or more budget lines no longer belong to this source. Refresh and try again.
INVALID_DEPOSIT_STATUS_TRANSITION: This deposit status change is not allowed.
INVALID_DEPOSIT_DATE_FOR_STATUS: This date cannot be set for the deposit's current status.
OIDC_MISSING_EMAIL: Your identity provider did not supply an email address.
